spec.description: Site-to-site link monitor (UDP echo probes). Latency panels (Current RTT, Percentiles, Average, Jitter) are RTT in ms, derived from link_rtt_seconds (seconds) via histogram_quantile/rate; they gap during outages. Packet Loss = 100 * rate(link_probes_timed_out_total)/rate(link_probes_sent_total) — true network loss (UDP never retransmits), reading ~100% during a full outage; a shorter rate window catches shorter outages. The server-side link_server_probes_received_total is a cross-check on the client's sent counter.

spec.title: Current RTT
spec.description: Median (p50) round-trip time over the last 5 minutes, in ms. No RTT samples during an outage -> gap; check Link Status.

spec.title: Adaptive RTO
spec.description: Probe timeout in use over time (ms). Rises on consecutive timeouts so loss detection recovers from latency jumps; floor tracks 2x smoothed RTT.

spec.title: Link Status
spec.description: 1 = up, 0 = down (after 3 consecutive missed probes). Latency panels show a gap while 0 (no RTT samples).

spec.title: Packet Loss
spec.description: Packet loss % over the last 5 minutes: 100 * rate(timed_out)/rate(sent). Reads ~100% during a full outage. Short outages appear as bumps, not full 100%.

spec.title: Adaptive RTO
spec.description: Current probe timeout (RFC 6298, floor max(200ms, 2xSRTT)), in ms. Grows during degradation; pins at max during sustained loss.

spec.title: Latency Percentiles
spec.description: RTT percentiles (p50/p90/p99) over a 5-minute window in ms, where gaps indicate outages. p50 reflects typical median performance, while p90 and p99 highlight tail latency and worst-case outliers that standard averages hide.

spec.title: Packet Loss
spec.description: Packet loss % over time, 5-minute window: 100 * rate(timed_out)/rate(sent). Reads ~100% during a full outage. Pick a rate window >= the outage you want to see as a full 100% block.

spec.title: Average Latency
spec.description: Mean RTT over a 5-minute window, in ms: rate(sum)/rate(count). Gaps = outage.

spec.title: Link Status (history)
spec.description: Connection state over time: 1 = up, 0 = down after 3 consecutive missed probes. Cross-reference with Packet Loss (100% while down).

spec.title: Probe Throughput
spec.description: Probes per second: rate(link_probes_sent_total). Probes are always sent at the interval cadence — even into a down link, where they time out and read as 100% loss.

spec.title: Link Monitor
